title: Special Executive Program in Business Management
description: The course provides students with a comprehensive understanding of the principles and practices of managing a business effectively.
longDescription: The aim of a Business Management course is to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the principles and practices of managing a business effectively. The course aims to develop students' knowledge and skills in areas such as organizational behavior, marketing, finance, accounting, operations management, human resource management, and strategic management. The course also aims to provide students with practical skills and knowledge that they can apply in real-world situations. This includes the ability to analyze business problems, develop and implement strategies, manage teams, and communicate effectively with stakeholders.
courseDetails: Understand the nature, relevant concepts, skills, and processes of the following business functions; Business Marketing. Business Communication. Financial affairs and management. Learn how Sales Management is carried out during different business cycles. Understand the whole mechanism of Supply chain Management and its practical implications. Understand the Management Information System, its different tools and the difference between MIS and IT. Understand the Legal Business Framework. Learn about Stakeholder’s nature, engagement and analysis. Understand the Logistics, imports and Exports aspects of a business. Learn how to run a business. Understand the Requirements of a financial plan. Learn what the marketing plan is. Understand the business plan and its contents.
